attrs.name: NH4 uptake
attrs.doc:
NH4 uptake model. By default, this will be identical to the NO3 uptake
     model.

attrs.name: MaxWidth
attrs.doc: Maximum horizontal distance of roots from plant.

attrs.name: MxNH4Up
attrs.doc: Maximum NH4 uptake per unit root length.

attrs.name: MxNO3Up
attrs.doc: Maximum NO3 uptake per unit root length.

attrs.name: DensityDSFac
attrs.doc: DS based factor for effective root density.

attrs.name: partial soil temperature
attrs.doc: Soil temperature hours this day, so far.

attrs.name: partial day
attrs.doc: Hours we have accumulated soil temperature this day.

attrs.name: water stress days
attrs.doc:
Number of days production has halted due to water stress. This is the sum
     of water stress for each hour, multiplied with the fraction of the radition of
     that day that was received that hour.

attrs.name: EffectiveDensity
attrs.doc:
Effective root density in soil layers. This takes heterogeneous distribution of
     roots in soil into account.

attrs.name: H2OExtraction
attrs.doc: Extraction of H2O in soil layers.

attrs.name: NH4Extraction
attrs.doc: Extraction of NH4-N in soil layers.

attrs.name: NO3Extraction
attrs.doc: Extraction of NO3-N in soil layers.

attrs.name: ABAExtraction
attrs.doc: Extraction of ABA in soil layers.

attrs.name: water stress
attrs.doc: Fraction of requested water we didn’t get.

attrs.name: production stress
attrs.doc: SVAT induced stress, or -1 if not applicable.

sections.text:
Roots that takes up water and nitrogen.
  < uptake (Rad 0.005 [cm])
               (ABAprod ABAprod )                      ; Default none value.
               (NH4 uptake NH4 uptake )
               (NO3 uptake NO3 uptake )                ; Default fixed sink value.
               (MaxPen 100 [cm])
               (MaxWidth MaxWidth )
               (h wp -15000 [cm])
               (MxNH4Up 2.5e-07 [g/cm/h])
               (MxNO3Up 2.5e-07 [g/cm/h])
               (Rxylem 10 [])
               (DensityDSFac DensityDSFac )            ; Has default value.
               (PotRtDpt PotRtDpt )
               (Depth Depth )
               (Density Density ...)
               (ABAConc 0 [g/cm3 ])
               (h x 0 [cm])
               (partial soil temperature 0 [dg C h])
               (partial day 0 [h])
               (soil temperature 0 [dg C])
               (water stress days 0 [d]) >

    Rad : number [cm]
     Parameter (default 0.005)
     Root radius.

    ABAprod : ABAproduction component (see chapter 7)
     Component (default ‘none’)
     ABA production model.

    NH4 uptake: solute uptake component (see chapter 81)
     Optional component
     NH4 uptake model. By default, this will be identical to the NO3 uptake
     model.

       NO3 uptake: solute uptake component (see chapter 81)
        Component (default ‘fixed sink’)
        NO3 uptake model.
       MaxPen: number [cm]
        Parameter (default 100)
        Maximum penetration depth.
       MaxWidth: number [cm]
        Optional parameter
        Maximum horizontal distance of roots from plant.
       h wp: number [cm]
        Parameter (default -15000)
        Matrix potential at wilting point.
       MxNH4Up: number [g/cm/h]
        Parameter (default 2.5e-07)
        Maximum NH4 uptake per unit root length.
       MxNO3Up: number [g/cm/h]
        Parameter (default 2.5e-07)
        Maximum NO3 uptake per unit root length.
       Rxylem: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 10)
        Transport resistence in xyleme.
       DensityDSFac: plf [DS → <none>]
        Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
        DS based factor for effective root density.
       PotRtDpt: number [cm]
        Optional state variable
        Potential root penetration depth.
       Depth: number [cm]
        Optional state variable
        Rooting Depth.
       Density: number [cm/cm3 ] soil cells
        Optional state variable
        Root density in soil layers.
       ABAConc: number [g/cm3 ]
        State variable (default 0)
        ABA concentration in water uptake.
       h x : number [cm]
        State variable (default 0)
        Root extraction at surface.
       partial soil temperature: number [dg C h]
        State variable (default 0)
        Soil temperature hours this day, so far.
       partial day: number [h]
        State variable (default 0)
        Hours we have accumulated soil temperature this day.

    soil temperature: number [dg C]
     State variable (default 0)
     Average soil temperature yesterday.

    water stress days: number [d]
     State variable (default 0)
     Number of days production has halted due to water stress. This is the sum
     of water stress for each hour, multiplied with the fraction of the radition of
     that day that was received that hour.

Log Variables
    EffectiveDensity: number [cm/cm3 ] soil cells
     Effective root density in soil layers. This takes heterogeneous distribution of
     roots in soil into account.

    H2OExtraction: number [cm3 /cm3 /h] soil cells
     Extraction of H2O in soil layers.

    NH4Extraction: number [g N/cm3 /h] soil cells
     Extraction of NH4-N in soil layers.

    NO3Extraction: number [g N/cm3 /h] soil cells
     Extraction of NO3-N in soil layers.

    ABAExtraction: number [g/cm3 /h] soil cells
     Extraction of ABA in soil layers.

    water stress: number (dimensionless)
     Fraction of requested water we didn’t get.

    production stress: number (dimensionless)
     SVAT induced stress, or -1 if not applicable.

    Ept: number [mm/h]
     Potential transpiration.

    H2OUpt: number [mm/h]
     H2O uptake.

    NH4Upt: number [g N/m2 /h]
     NH4-N uptake.

    NO3Upt: number [g N/m2 /h]
     NO3-N uptake.

attrs.name: PenpFFac
attrs.doc:
Moisture dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with. If pressure is less than
        -1 cm, pF will be assumed to be 0.

attrs.name: PenClayFac
attrs.doc: Clay dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with.

attrs.name: PenWaterFac
attrs.doc:
Water dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with. The factor is a function
        of relative water content (Theta/Theta sat).

attrs.name: PenDSFac
attrs.doc: Development stage dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with.

sections.text:
A ‘uptake’ base model (see 72.1, page 401) build into Daisy.
   Root zone grow mostly as function of thermal age.

  < zone       (DptEmr 10 [cm])
               (PenPar1 0.25 [cm/dg C/d])
               (PenPar2 4 [dg C])
               (PenpFFac PenpFFac )                  ; Has default value.
               (PenClayFac PenClayFac )              ; Has default value.
               (PenWaterFac PenWaterFac )            ; Has default value.
               (PenDSFac PenDSFac )                  ; Has default value.
               ;; Shared parameters are described in section 72.1.
               (Rad 0.005 [cm])
               (ABAprod ABAprod )                    ; Default none value.
               (NH4 uptake NH4 uptake )
               (NO3 uptake NO3 uptake )              ; Default fixed sink value.
               (MaxPen 100 [cm])
               (MaxWidth MaxWidth )
               (h wp -15000 [cm])
               (MxNH4Up 2.5e-07 [g/cm/h])
               (MxNO3Up 2.5e-07 [g/cm/h])
               (Rxylem 10 [])
               (DensityDSFac DensityDSFac )          ; Has default value.
               (PotRtDpt PotRtDpt )
               (Depth Depth )
               (Density Density ...)
               (ABAConc 0 [g/cm3 ])
               (h x 0 [cm])
               (partial soil temperature 0 [dg C h])
               (partial day 0 [h])
               (soil temperature 0 [dg C])
               (water stress days 0 [d]) >

       DptEmr : number [cm]
        Parameter (default 10)
        Penetration at emergence.

       PenPar1 : number [cm/dg C/d]
        Parameter (default 0.25)
        Penetration rate parameter, coefficient.

       PenPar2 : number [dg C]
        Parameter (default 4)
        Penetration rate parameter, threshold.

       PenpFFac: plf [pF → <none>]
        Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
        Moisture dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with. If pressure is less than
        -1 cm, pF will be assumed to be 0.

       PenClayFac: plf [<fraction> → <none>]
        Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
        Clay dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with.

       PenWaterFac: plf [<fraction> → <none>]
        Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
        Water dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with. The factor is a function
        of relative water content (Theta/Theta sat).

    PenDSFac: plf [DS → <none>]
     Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
     Development stage dependent factor to multiply ’PenPar1’ with.
